text:
Inside Amazon's plan to unite games, movies and TV – including "more games in development than at any point in our history"

Amazon has announced that its Luna video game streaming service will be incorporated into Prime Video, allowing Prime subscribers to play games directly through the video app. It follows similar moves at Netflix, where gaming titles were made available as part of the main video streaming service, leading to a "strong uptake" by players as a result.
